title: Tooling: 1.70x faster exact historical ternary frame checks (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.**

This opt-in tool speeds up the historical ternary frame checker by caching results for exact ordered frame pairs. It retains both orientations, every physical edge, and the existing rational arithmetic. Complete matrix-and-edge transcripts and published small-control fields for h=8 and h=9 match the retained checker. Timings use alternating fresh processes. The h=29 construction is not replayed, and kappa is unchanged.

## Task and overlap

- Base: `1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`. Seed: **93**.
- Scope: `ternary-h8-h9-physical-edge-pair-memoization`; [task card](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cb5a79f12531022c6fcd2fe592b5030d4e3ae9e7/research/ternary-frame-cache/CLAIM.json), [20 exact source pins](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cb5a79f12531022c6fcd2fe592b5030d4e3ae9e7/research/ternary-frame-cache/SOURCES.json).
- Nearest work: #154 (scheduling/paired-cube frames), #367 (PR364 integer elimination). Object here: historical `ternary_side.verify_invocation_frames`; original rational routines and full schedule retained.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B research/ternary-frame-cache/verify.py --out /tmp/ternary-frame-cache-93 --pairs 3
```

Expected: `PASS_IDENTICAL_TERNARY_FRAME_REPLAY 84672 edges; ... ratio of medians`. Fresh output directory required.

| Local Python 3.14.6 / macOS arm64, three alternating pairs | Reference | Cached |
|---|---:|---:|
| Median wall seconds | 11.525 | 6.775 |

Ratio of medians: **1.70**. Peak RSS: **96.30 → 105.17 MiB**. Shared host; OS caches not flushed.

- Exact comparison: all **84,672** ordered edge records, full rational matrices, graph and scalar receipts.
- **18 tests** on Python 3.11 and 3.14; full replay on both; **5 original ternary tests**; selected-source binding passed.
- Controls: singular Gram, missing common pair, non-idempotence, wrong target/role, rank-only and hash-collision keys, reversed transitions, all 20 source mutations, transcript omissions/duplicates/reordering, disabled assertions, reused output.
- Excluded: h=29 DAG/full historical assembly, selected cold replay, all-size multiplication proof.
- Retained source, `upstream/`, selected certificate and default checker: unchanged.

[Adapter diff](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cb5a79f12531022c6fcd2fe592b5030d4e3ae9e7/research/ternary-frame-cache/evidence/ADAPTATION.diff) · [Timing and exact receipts](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cb5a79f12531022c6fcd2fe592b5030d4e3ae9e7/research/ternary-frame-cache/evidence/benchmark-python314.json) · [Validation](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cb5a79f12531022c6fcd2fe592b5030d4e3ae9e7/research/ternary-frame-cache/evidence/validation.json)
